Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 14,398Chapters: 8/20Kudos: 31

Summary: For years, he carved lines into the earth and runes into his own skin. Now, it is time to crack both open and drag the future back to his King. But, as warned in the days of old, nothing is brought back without a cost. He is a king-maker who has outlived his sovereign; a warlock who has finally stopped bartering with words and started bartering with existence. He will pay any price if it means his heart never goes where he cannot follow him again. Merlin burrows to a past that hasn't yet bled, and is no longer the bumbling servant Camelot remembers. He is something older, hungrier, and powerful beyond measure. This time, Arthur will not just wear a crown; Merlin will carve him into a god to match his own dark divinity. And if it takes a little blood to bind them together, to ensure what he is owed, who he earned, then Merlin will gladly teach his prince how to thirst for it.
